A carrier that raises does NOT swallow the poke — it lands carrying carry_failed (Law 7, Akien's no-silent-failure rule). shim._fire posts cb.payload(context), so the bus's one producer now carries the moment, not the declaration.

standing: PROVED — A POKE PER CROSSING, NOT PER PULSE. Akien: 'so we need an anti-bounce?' Now the default is one poke at the crossing false->true, re-arming when the line is recrossed; Callback.while_true opts back into per-pulse for the watch that means 'keep telling me while this holds'. WATCHME is physics at the one door: a node crossing forward out of a watch it carried must have EMITTED — the probe on disk, armed, its trigger/enough/carrier/nexus/consumer spec'd AT TICKETING. That inverts the LEARNME failure exactly: v1's summons sat in the backbone, mandatory for every node and gated by nothing, so it was crossed by every voyage and satisfied by none. WATCHME is OPTIONAL TO CARRY, MANDATORY TO SATISFY ONCE CARRIED, and 'none, because X' is the only other legal answer — silence is not. A probe carries no authority: it deposits and pokes, and probe.py cannot reach this chokepoint by any import or call, so the back-edge stays the owner's act (Law 6). WHAT THE VOYAGE ACTUALLY LEARNED, in the order it hurt. (1) The first live fire caught its builder twice where four green proofs had not: the corpus counted THIS ticket — the node that invented the mechanism, counting its own participation as evidence that authors participate — and `enough` had no sample floor while `_trigger` required 12, so the watch could CLEAR at n=1 but not FIRE until n=12. It was guaranteed to retire before it could ever bite: the v1 failure wearing this node's own clothes. (2) The rename falsified this ticket's own chart refs BY SUCCEEDING — the crossing was refused with five findings naming addresses piece (f) had renamed hours earlier — and the fix was a forwarding order on the record plus a both-ends filter, never editing the berths to match. H1 dies of this: in a system that checks refs in the world, no rename is behaviour-free, and an enumerated sweep list is a hypothesis about completeness, not a statement of it (bus-completion.json's live spec named three addresses the list never mentioned). (3) H4 dies of a sharper one: the skill-class precedent 'a version lands in the class file ALONE' did not transfer, because WATCHME roams and names its object and v1's fixed-position grammar could not express that. A precedent transfers on the shape of the CHANGE, not the shape of the artifact. (4) At this validate step the ticket's own falsifier clause (2) measured UNMET — a probe armed and never firing, with nothing loud about it — while this node's probe correctly HOLDS and will stand silent for many voyages. That is the LEARNME disease one level up, and the constrain berth's TEETH bound had named it and it was dropped between constrain and decompose. So it was built here, in bounds: a probe declares a `horizon` in PULSES (a clock is bounded OUT; the shim already counts pulses) and an armed-never-fired watch past it surfaces under its OWN key carrying its own numbers. WHAT IS OWED, named not glossed: nothing pulses this shim today (the wall-clock backing is a filed edge), so that loudness rides BaseShim.overdue() alone; _HORIZON=1000 is honest as a placeholder and dishonest as a measurement; build_inspector still stands at LEARNME under its own ticket and migrates on its next crossing, by its own owner; and test_needs.py is red for a PRE-EXISTING stage_needs two-vocabulary collision that needs Akien's ruling.
